title: Grateful Dead Live at Lakeland Civic Center on 1982-09-12
lineage: Cassette Master (Sony TC-K677ES) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Pristine, reverb‑rich audience capture of a solid 1982 show featuring a standout entrance into "The Wheel" and great renditions of Not Fade Away, Deal and Sugar Magnolia.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers an unusually clean and bright sound with a heavy natural reverb that gives the mix a heavenly quality. Musically the concert is praised for tight playing, especially the opening of "The Wheel" and memorable segments of Not Fade Away, Deal and Sugar Magnolia. Overall the audio and performance are both highly enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4‑5 stars and highlighted strong performances and a clear, well‑balanced recording; the weighted average suggests a rating in the high‑four range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Heavy natural reverb from board‑side mics gives a bright, upfront sound that is described as pristine, clean and crisp; no significant dropouts or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid set with smooth transitions, highlighted by a particularly nice entrance into "The Wheel" and well‑placed classic segments.
